# kestrel-chartkit golden reference fixture: fixed-rate bond difference tests
#
# Reference values generated offline from an independent second implementation that prices
# over an explicit payment schedule; generator, pinned version and conventions are recorded in
# the local project documentation, not in this repository.
#
# Conventions: unadjusted schedule without holiday calendar, Actual/365Fixed, compounded at the
# coupon frequency, zero settlement days. Prices are absolute amounts, not per-100 quotes.
#
# The cases deliberately include settlement exactly on a coupon date and settlement between
# coupon dates: the crate's simplified schedule agrees with the first and differs on the
# second.

# case counts
meta_bond_case_count=7.0
meta_scheduled_case_count=4.0
